title: Purchasing power of Town salaries
method: Each 2026 authorized salary is set against the first authorized salary the Town Board's January resolutions show for the same person (2018 to 2026), carried forward by the New York-area CPI-U. Annual CPI is the average of the months published; 2026 averages the months through 2026-10. Within 2% of that carried-forward figure counts as about even (equilibrium). The first salary on file is a starting salary only for people hired in 2018 or later; for earlier hires it is their 2018 salary. Authorized salary is base pay, not overtime or other pay. Names are matched to payroll hire dates by name. Board members and stipends are left out.
